name: UNSW Access Scholarship
summary: Yearly scholarship for commencing local UNSW undergraduates who have experienced educational disadvantage.
key: $10,000 per annum for the minimum duration of program.
who: Commencing a UNSW eligible undergraduate coursework degree
Australian citizen, permanent resident or NZ citizen
how: Apply through UAC for an Equity Scholarship (ES) or EAS; Gateway applicants are considered automatically
catches: 2027 rounds: EAS via UAC by 19 Nov 2026, ES by 10 Dec 2026, with later January and February rounds; offers made through to March 2027
Competitive; meeting the criteria does not guarantee an award

source.label: UNSW Scholarships: UNSW Equity Scholarships for 2027

evidence.quote: $10,000 per annum for the minimum duration of program
Supports and encourages local students who have experienced educational disadvantage
